findings: All 32 overlapping course views and both access-area contexts inspected. Source follows the main river corridor.

Explicit original way685794204 is used between shared nodes4364483336 and6427468321. It follows the open river instead of the obsolete western source detour in the other main-way portion. Original node coordinates and way order are retained.

Original generalized chords cross local bank/vegetated points in panels10–11 and17 and exposed bars in other bends. They are retained only as a disclosed general river-course overview, with no navigable-channel, distance-adoption, bank-side or remaining-time approval.
WDFW access markers and IDs remain unchanged. No connector is drawn to a surveyed landing.
